maria.g: Heads-up — a Dedicated GPU deploy failed in us-west-2, looks like KMS decrypt denied for node SA when trying to unwrap model keys.
kevin.l: Can you paste the failing error log?
maria.g: From infra logs: 
```
E0320 10:12:09.234 kubelet.go:215] Error: failed to mount secret "redwood-model-enc": failed to call KMS.Decrypt: PermissionDenied: Key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd decrypt failed for principal system:serviceaccount:gpu-pool:gpu-node-runner
```
ashley: That SA shouldn't have KMS decrypt perms in prod. We just tightened KMS IAM last week — maybe we missed a mapping.
jonathan: Did the recent RBAC annotation change fold in the node SA to the wrong role? I remember we annotated pods with `rbac.redwood.com/exec-role=deploy` in a batch update.
kevin.l: Right — we changed the annotation selector in the gpu pool controller. Old selector: `rbac.redwood.com/role: gpu-node`, new selector: `rbac.redwood.com/exec-role: gpu`. We forgot to update RoleBinding generation to map svcacct -> iam role for KMS.
sec-bot: alert: 1 unauthorized KMS decrypt attempt detected for key abcd by principal system:serviceaccount:gpu-pool:gpu-node-runner at 2026-03-20T10:12:09Z.
ashley: Short term: we can patch the RoleBinding to restore old mapping for that pool so decrypts succeed. But we should not grant broad KMS Decrypt to node SAs long term.
maria.g: Agreed. Patch helped on canary: `kubectl patch rolebinding gpu-kms-binding -n gpu-pool --patch '{"subjects":[{"kind":"ServiceAccount","name":"gpu-node-runner","namespace":"gpu-pool"}]}'` — after patch the pod succeeded to start.
kevin.l: We need an audit proof path: which deploys annotated pods with the new key? Use `kubectl get pods -n gpu-pool -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.metadata.annotations}\n'` to find others.
jonathan: I ran it, ~8 pods still have old annotations, ~2 have the new `exec-role` tag. The controller rollout started yesterday, so annotations are mixed.
sre-oncall: Rollback plan? If we revert the controller selector, we'll unmap the new role feature which is used for scheduled batch inference. Risk: performance hits for batch jobs.
ashley: Proposed plan: 1) Immediate fix: add a narrow KMS grant to specific RoleBinding for gpu-node-runner in gpu-pool only — auditor-friendly, TTL 1 hour. 2) Patch controller to create RoleBindings that map the new annotation to a new IAM role with least privilege (Decrypt only for envelope key ids used by that pool). 3) Add a cluster audit rule to detect any KMS decrypt denies and notify #eng-oncall.
maria.g: +1. Implementing step 1 now. Patch command applied, verified in logs: `KMS Decrypt Succeeded` for the canary.
kevin.l: For step 2 — here's a YAML diff we should apply to controller generator: 
```
- selector: matchLabels:
-   rbac.redwood.com/role: gpu-node
+ selector: matchLabels:
+   rbac.redwood.com/exec-role: gpu
```
And update RoleBinding template subject -> `serviceAccountName: {{ .podSA }}` plus annotation -> `iam.amazonaws.com/role: arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-gpu-decrypt-{{ .pool }}`.
jonathan: Also add an admission webhook check that refuses annotation changes that would grant KMS decrypt unless a reviewed label is present: `security.review/approved: "true"`. That will force manual review for new mappings.
sre-oncall: For incident timeline and RCA, capture: who applied selector change, PR link, and the exact commit. I can pull the git history.
sec-bot: note: create finding in backlog: KMS-annot-on-gpu-2026-03-20, severity medium, tags [rbac, kms, gpu-pool].
ashley: Vulnerability triage: low blast radius (single pool), no data exfil detected, decrypt denied shows no plaintext leaked. Severity: medium due to availability impact.
maria.g: Postmortem action items I suggest: 1) Controller change PR with unit tests; 2) Add e2e that simulates KMS decrypt failure; 3) Audit rule + pager for repeated denies; 4) Run a quick IAM policy review for all node SAs.\eon: typo — meant to tag @kevin.l on item 4.
kevin.l: I'll own PR + tests, aiming for hotfix today. Will also run quick IAM diff and post in this thread.
jonathan: I'm on the webhook admission work, will open PR and link.
sre-oncall: I'll update the incident tracker and schedule a 30-min postmortem sync at 1600 UTC.
maria.g: Thanks everyone. After hotfix we should tighten the ephemeral patch TTL to 15m and confirm rollback path. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy gpu-controller v2.3.7-hotfix started by kevin.l at 2026-03-20T11:42:00Z
kevin.l: Hotfix deployed to canary, monitoring logs now. No further KMS denies in the canary.
sec-bot: resolved alert: KMS decrypt denies cleared for key abcd.
maria.g: Closing the immediate thread; will add final RCA when the PM notes are ready.
